name: windows.etwpatch.EtwPatch
desc: Identifies ETW (Event Tracing for Windows) patching techniques used by malware to evade detection. This plugin examines the first opcode of key ETW functions in ntdll.dll and advapi32.dll to detect common ETW bypass techniques such as return pointer manipulation (RET) or function redirection (JMP). Attackers often patch these functions to prevent security tools from receiving telemetry about process execution, API calls, and other system events.
